metadata.scope: Official HRM 2026/27 Capital Multi-Year Projects schedule from the revised March 3, 2026 capital-plan report.
metadata.principle: Attachment 2 is a budget cashflow/authority schedule for identified multi-year projects and programs. It is not a complete capital-project ledger, project spend-to-date, invoice evidence, commitment ledger, final project cost or proof of an overrun.

known_source_control_discrepancies.note: All 29 discrete project rows individually reconcile to their own source Grand Total, but their previous-years values sum one dollar above the printed discrete-project subtotal.
The one-dollar discrete previous-years subtotal defect carries into the printed discrete-project Grand Total.

The source final Grand Total row repeats the printed discrete-project previous-years subtotal and therefore omits the ongoing-program previous-years subtotal of 464,747,445; it also inherits the discrete subtotal's one-dollar defect.
The one-dollar discrete-project subtotal defect carries into the source final schedule Grand Total. All other fiscal-year columns reconcile to project-row sums.

approval_source.name: Regional Council — Ratification from Budget Committee, Proposed 2026/27 Budget
approval_source.approval_text: Regional Council adopted the Resolution for Approval of Operating Budgets, Capital Plan and Tax Rates for Fiscal 2026/27 as set out in Schedule 1 of the March 25, 2026 staff report.
approval_source.interpretation_boundary: Council approval establishes capital budget authority. It does not establish that a scheduled amount was spent, committed, invoiced or paid.
